chars.SON: SON: a young man wearing a brand-new dark navy suit, crisp white shirt and a bright red tie.
chars.DAD: DAD: an older man with a thick grey moustache wearing a beige djellaba and yellow babouche slippers.
chars.MOM: BRIDEMOM: a middle-aged woman wearing an emerald-green caftan with gold trim and a cream headscarf.
chars.GIRL: GIRL: a young woman wearing a pastel pink caftan and a white headscarf.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a traditional Moroccan salon with long patterned sofas and zellige walls. DAD has suddenly stood up from the sofa with a stern shocked face, pointing to the door; SON sits beside him holding a bouquet of roses, confused; BRIDEMOM sits opposite, startled. A silver tea tray lies tipped over on the carpet with spilled tea glasses.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon. DAD firmly hands SON a bouquet of roses and a gold box of chocolates, telling him to get up and leave; SON stands up awkwardly, wide-eyed, holding the gifts.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon. BRIDEMOM stands in the middle of the room with her hands raised in confusion, mouth open; behind her GIRL half-hides behind a doorway curtain, covering her mouth, tearful. A tipped silver tea tray on the carpet.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Front door of a Moroccan house at evening. DAD walks out quickly ahead with a hard face; SON follows behind in his suit, carrying the roses and chocolate box, looking back over his shoulder in confusion.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: A quiet Moroccan street at dusk next to an old parked car. DAD slaps his own forehead with his palm in frustration and regret; SON stands next to him in his suit, holding the roses, baffled.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Inside a parked car at night in a Moroccan street. SON in his suit sits in the passenger seat staring worriedly at his phone screen glowing in his hand, the bouquet of roses lying on his lap.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: A modest Moroccan family living room at night with a low round table. DAD sits on the sofa and pulls SON down to sit beside him, leaning in with a serious, heavy face as if about to reveal a secret; SON in his loosened suit looks at him anxiously.
